claims.claim: A linear GLS Distance Network model has been implemented end-to-end.
A baseline H0 is produced from the minimal dataset with full covariance.
Multiple analysis variants are produced (anchor subsets, primary-indicator subsets, secondary-indicator subsets, jackknife by host).
Per-observation information weights are quantified, identifying which measurements drive the H0 constraint.
Goodness of fit and residual diagnostics are reported.
A sensitivity analysis (intrinsic-scatter rescaling and outlier jackknife) is included.
The result is contextualised against early-universe (CMB/Planck) and SH0ES values.
Software and data products are released alongside the report.
